text: Handling deadlines is an important skill for students and workers. Good time management helps you plan your tasks and avoid last-minute stress. Start by prioritising your work: finish the most urgent or important tasks first. Scope management is also key, because trying to do too much can make you miss your deadline. Be realistic about what you can complete. Finally, communication matters. If you think you may be late, tell your teacher, manager, or team early. They can often help or adjust the plan. With clear planning and honest communication, deadlines become much easier to manage.
